required_outputs: primary source-local rank estimand and cluster-aware interval
row, batch, source/laboratory and resolvable biological-unit counts
environment, command, stdout/stderr and output hashes
protected_input_rules: Evaluator selects or generates the protected held-out input independently.
Authors receive no row-level protected input, intermediate predictions, tuning traces or failure-level logs before the signed aggregate receipt is finalized.
Only aggregate results and non-sensitive audit hashes may be returned to the authors.
The evaluator preserves negative, failed and deviating runs rather than returning only successful results.
prohibited_substitutes: row-level input or intermediate output disclosure
claim_boundary: This work package makes a protected evaluation executable; it is not a lockbox receipt and cannot close the independent-validation gate by itself.
